purpose: Mechanism and engineering checks only; not a confirmatory conference benchmark
direction: Language candidate costs plus inverse optimization, with independent bounded-noise decision checks
feedback: Uniform selection among all feasible actions whose true absolute cost gap is within the declared bound; known simulated bound supplied, hidden truth not supplied to certificate
primary_checks: Every safe certificate has true deployment regret <= threshold
An independent 2D exact-rational polygon oracle lies within returned risk bounds
A correct noise bound does not produce incompatible status
All returned coordinate outer bounds contain the simulated true coordinates
reported_metrics: old empirical profile containment, explicitly not confidence coverage
true decision regret and conditional worst-case regret
failure_policy: Keep every failure and original output. Any invalid upper/lower certificate blocks success. Do not select seeds or relax budgets after results.
limitations: The two noise conditions share an instance; not independent samples
These generators are development data and cannot become final held-out evidence
Candidate structure is supplied, no LLM understanding claim
No proof of novelty or CCF A readiness
Only finite small decision sets; relative noise and general continuous deployment unsupported
Time is cooperative, including exact arithmetic overhead; report actual elapsed time
